outOfScope.reason: Engineering records: the project's reasoning, not its voice. Rewriting 50k words of decision history by hand would buy nothing.
The Contributor Covenant, a standard text authored by neither a person here nor a model. Rewriting it to sound like us would defeat the point of adopting it.
Only the files listed in include ship prose, and every handler is read for its {"error":"..."} bodies alone, so log lines and SQL stay out.
